cells.name: hodgepodge
cells.species: the hodgepodge machine — a Belousov–Zhabotinsky-style reaction CA
eq: healthy (s = 0):  s′ = ⌊a/k₁⌋ + ⌊b/k₂⌋  (a infected, b ill neighbours)
infected (0 < s < 100):  s′ = ⌊mean of s and infected neighbours⌋ + g

cells.name: lenia
cells.species: Lenia: continuous Life with a ring kernel and a bell growth
eq: U = K ∗ A,  K(r) = exp(−(r/R − ½)²/(2·0.15²)),  R = 6 (ring kernel)

cells.name: smoothlife
cells.species: SmoothLife: inner/outer disc sums through sigmoids
eq: m = mean over r ≤ 2.3,  n = mean over 2.3 < r ≤ 7
S(n, m) = σ(n − mix(b₁, d₁, σₘ))·(1 − σ(n − mix(b₂, d₂, σₘ)))
